title: LinkedIn Outreach
tagline: Using connection requests and direct messages on LinkedIn to start conversations with the exact buyers you want.
excerpt: Connection requests and messages on LinkedIn, aimed at the exact decision-makers you want to reach.
definition: Reaching prospects directly on LinkedIn through connection requests, messages, and follow-ups, using the platform's job and company data to target the exact decision-makers you want.
body: LinkedIn's advantage is context: the prospect can see your profile, mutual connections, and what you post before deciding to reply, so a credible profile does part of the selling. The trade-off is volume, since weekly connection limits cap how many people you can reach, which is why many teams pair LinkedIn with cold email rather than choosing one.
furtherLabel: Read: Cold Email vs. LinkedIn Outreach for B2B Pipeline
schemaDescription: LinkedIn outreach is the practice of contacting prospects directly on LinkedIn through connection requests, direct messages, and follow-ups, using the platform's professional data to target specific decision-makers.
metaDescription: What LinkedIn outreach is, how LinkedIn prospecting and LinkedIn lead generation work, and how it compares with cold email.
